observation: The published dashboard skill mirror differed from its canonical .codex skill and failed the enforced mirror gate.

evidence.observation: Baseline output: Docs skill mirror mismatch: observability-dashboard/SKILL.md. Post-fix output: AI governance surfaces checked successfully.

expected: The docs mirror is generated from the canonical runtime skill and the mirror check exits zero.
actual: The baseline mirror omitted the dashboard release gate and Run Explorer troubleshooting content present in the canonical skill.
impact: Operators could follow stale validation guidance, and the required governance gate failed.
root_cause: The docs skill mirror had not been refreshed after the canonical runtime skill changed.
remediation: Refresh the docs skill mirror with the governance synchronizer and keep the existing mirror gate required.

observation: The governance normalizer contradicted the architecture contract for CODEX-RUNTIME canonical links, while the runtime doctor did not report normalization drift.

evidence.observation: The normalized result lacked RULES, requirements, ADR, memory, and post-change tokens required by the architecture test.
Post-fix doctor output is {ok: true, findings: []} and now includes normalization findings.

expected: All governance normalizers preserve file-specific required tokens, and the runtime doctor fails on pending normalization.
actual: A common two-link block was previously imposed on CODEX-RUNTIME even though that surface requires seven canonical links.
impact: Running the advertised synchronizer could create architecture drift while its own checks appeared green.
root_cause: The normalizer used one canonical-source template for every agent file and was not wired into the doctor.
remediation: Use a CODEX-RUNTIME-specific canonical block and include check-only normalization findings in doctor static diagnostics.
automation: doctor static diagnostics plus architecture test

observation: The Bash Vibe launcher printed the complete operator prompt, and both launchers recommended a pipe-to-shell installer.
method: git show origin/main:scripts/ai/vibe/launch.sh; git show origin/main:scripts/ai/vibe/launch.ps1; static unsafe-pattern scan

evidence.observation: Baseline line 103 was log_info "Prompt: $*"; baseline line 82 recommended curl ... | bash.
Baseline PowerShell guidance wrapped curl ... | bash in WSL.
Post-fix contract scans both launchers for full-prompt logging and pipe-to-shell guidance.

expected: Launchers never write prompt content to stdout and never recommend executing an unverified download through a shell.
actual: The baseline launcher exposed the full prompt to terminal logs and offered unsafe installation guidance.
impact: Prompts can contain sensitive task data; logs may persist or be collected, and pipe-to-shell guidance creates supply-chain execution risk.
root_cause: Launcher diagnostics logged user payload content and had no automated safety contract for operator-facing install text.
remediation: Log prompt length only, retain pip/pipx install guidance, and enforce forbidden patterns in the native runtime contract.

observation: The memory retention check reports 13 expired episodic records and sets policy_violation=true.

evidence.observation: candidate_count=13, active_count=275, density_excess=0, invalid_metadata=[], policy_violation=true, exit 1.

expected: Expired episodic records are pruned by an authorized retention workflow and prune --check exits zero.
actual: Thirteen records exceeded ttl_days=14; no records were removed during the audit.
impact: Expired working memory remains searchable and the retention policy gate stays red.
root_cause: Scheduled or operator-authorized pruning had not removed expired episodic records by the audit timestamp.
remediation: Review the 13-candidate dry-run, then run the authorized prune apply workflow and re-run validation.
dependencies: explicit authorization for destructive retention apply
automation: memory.tooling.prune retention gate; apply remains explicitly authorized

observation: Generated full-paste project prompts copied source-relative links without rebasing and failed the documentation link gate with 12 broken links.

evidence.observation: Baseline detected link drift in audit-cyclic-pack.md and audit-sequential-run.md; sync rebased 12 links.
Post-fix project_full_link_drift=0 and prompt check exits zero.

expected: Generated prompt links resolve from the generated output directory, and prompt checks detect skipped rebasing.
actual: Eleven cycle links in audit-cyclic-pack.md and one in audit-sequential-run.md resolved only beside their source cards.
impact: The required docs link gate failed and operators following full-paste prompts reached missing pages.
root_cause: The render workflow preserved Markdown link text while moving the body two directories deeper.
remediation: Add deterministic source-aware link rebasing, expose check/sync CLI modes, and include drift in the prompt gate.
